label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: British Open Lead
items.text: Ryan Fox leads the British Open at Royal Birkdale by one shot after a clutch 175-yard 9-iron birdie on the 72nd hole, sealing a potential first major victory.

items.headline: PGA Tour-Asian Tour Partnership
items.text: Rory McIlroy praised the PGA Tour/DP World Tour/Asian Tour partnership through 2029 that creates new pathways and co-sanctioned events, delivering a blow to LIV Golf’s Asian Tour ties.

items.headline: 3M Open Field Set
items.text: The 2026 3M Open field is finalized with 144 players at TPC Twin Cities, headlined by World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler and defending leader Kurt Kitayama.
